D04_reference.observable: lowest zero-momentum valence isovector pseudoscalar energy on S16T16 quenched Wilson, kappa=0.14
D04_reference.physical_interpretation: independent target for the dimensionless Pion fixed-protocol risk objective
D04_reference.reference_method: candidate-blind joint two-state PP(n=0,8,16)+local A4P spectral fit
D04_reference.data_source: independent E-chain; correlator receipt not yet supplied
D04_reference.pass_rule: relative mass error<=0.05; p>=0.01; PP/A4P and window/model shifts<=2.5 paired SE; no boundary hits
D04_reference.failure_rule: any failed reference gate makes D04 unresolved; do not substitute synthetic operator loss

D06_effect_threshold.direction_and_interpretation: rho=R_comparator/R_trainableW; rho>1 favors trainable-W; require at least 10% risk reduction
D06_effect_threshold.decision_rule: hull lower bound across block lengths must exceed r_star for both comparisons
D06_effect_threshold.invalid_or_zero_risk_rule: ABSTAIN_RATIO_UNDEFINED; do not add epsilon or change to an absolute-difference estimand

D11_strong_spectral_operator.basis_parameterization: monotone Bernstein controls mapped by a fixed exact dyadic rational degree-4 transform, evaluated in float64, to a Chebyshev series for Clenshaw application
D11_strong_spectral_operator.H_definition: H=sum_i(T_i+T_i^dagger-2I), three periodic spatial directions, equal-weight unitary 3x3 links
D11_strong_spectral_operator.identity_normalization: P4(1)=b4=1 at the zero mode; outer unnormalized G^2 P4(H) G^2 is common to all arms
D11_strong_spectral_operator.positivity_projection_constraints: Bernstein basis gives 0<=P4<=1; monotone controls imply dP4/dy>=0; no post-fit clipping or projection
D11_strong_spectral_operator.failure_rule: reject nonunitary links, wrong shape/boundary, nonfinite values, or infeasible controls; never repair by clipping

fair_budget.initialization_policy: freeze and hash one prespecified initialization plan; use matched starts where parameterizations permit
fair_budget.restart_policy: one prespecified start per arm; no unbudgeted restarts; retain failed runs in assigned-arm denominator
fair_budget.stopping_rule: stop at 160 objective/gradient calls or the prespecified solver tolerance; count all objective and gradient evaluations
fair_budget.hardware_environment: not yet measured; record CPU/GPU model, thread count, precision, software versions and clock policy
fair_budget.walltime_rule: charge full training/setup/selection cost to one task until a supported deployment task count and cost ledger exist
